args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate was 0.18 in us-east, us-west, and eu-west). Per the runbook, I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback completed and was verified. v2.3.1 is marked unhealthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging. Follow-up: confirm error rate has returned to baseline, investigate the v2.3.1 failure before any re-release, and check whether the incident is closed.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback is verified.

- **Why v2.3.0:** v2.3.1 is unhealthy in production, and v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy there. Before the rollback, checkout-api was on v2.3.1 in all regions, with an error rate of 0.18.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api. It describes the failed v2.3.1 deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0, and it paged the on-call engineer.

I did not re-check the error rate after the rollback, so confirming recovery is still open. The incident summary lists that as a follow-up, along with investigating the v2.3.1 failure before anyone re-releases it.
